description: This is a PHPUnit test class for the Banner model within the Goteo project. It contains tests for creating, saving, translating, listing, and deleting banner records, as well as handling associated images and language settings.
external_files: the test image file used during the tests

classes.name: BannerTest
classes.description: PHPUnit test class for Banner model, testing creation, translation, listing, deletion, and image handling.

methods.name: setUpBeforeClass
methods.description: Initializes test environment, sets language, creates a test image, and prepares test data.

methods.name: testInstance
methods.description: Verifies that an instance of Banner can be created.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Tests creation and saving of a Banner, including image and project/node associations.

methods.name: testSaveLanguages
methods.description: Tests saving translations for a Banner.

methods.name: testCheckLanguages
methods.description: Verifies that translations are correctly saved and retrieved.

methods.name: testListing
methods.description: Ensures banners are listed correctly in different language contexts.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Tests deleting a Banner and subsequent saving and redundant delete operations.

methods.name: testNonExisting
methods.description: Checks behavior when retrieving or deleting a non-existent Banner.

methods.name: tearDownAfterClass
methods.description: Cleans up by deleting test data and removing temporary image files.
